review_candidates.description: Do you love the moment a stubborn problem finally gives? Service Stream is looking for a Senior Digital Support Engineer who genuinely enjoys troubleshooting — someone who takes on the complex user issues others get stuck on, digs until they find the real cause, and delivers great service the whole way through. This is a hands-on technical role, not a step into management. It blends Service Desk responsibilities with deep End User Computing (EUC) expertise across Microsoft 365, Intune and Windows 11, and suits someone who has mastered frontline support and now wants consistently harder problems. Location : Rotating shift pattern between our Rockdale, Parramatta, Chatswood, Wetherill Park and Eastern Creek sites. Work type : Full time permanent. Working requirements: As this role supports our Defence contract, you must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Defence Security Clearance. This role is also based 5 days in office. About the Role As a Senior Digital Support Engineer, you’ll be the escalation point for the technical issues the wider team can’t resolve. You’ll work across endpoints, identity, enterprise applications and connectivity, spanning Windows 11, macOS, iOS and Android devices, Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune, to keep our people across Australia productive and connected. You’ll also make support better over time by finding permanent fixes rather than workarounds, automating repetitive tasks, strengthening knowledge base documentation, and lifting the technical capability of the engineers around you. What You’ll Do Own incidents and requests end to end via phone, email, ServiceNow and in person, keeping users informed at every step Diagnose problems across endpoints, identity, connectivity and applications, using logs, event data and diagnostic tools to find the real cause rather than the symptom Take the complex Level 2 and Level 3 escalations others cannot resolve, and drive them through to root cause and permanent fix Administer and troubleshoot Windows 11, macOS, iOS and Android devices, including Intune enrolment, compliance policies, Autopilot provisioning and patching Support and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, and resolve Entra ID sign-in, MFA and conditional access issues Provision, configure and rebuild devices for employee onboarding, offboarding and hardware refresh Use scripting and automation, such as PowerShell, to fix recurring problems at the source and reduce repeat tickets Write clear knowledge base articles and mentor other engineers, so fixes stick and the whole team improves What You’ll Bring Must be an Australian or NZ Citizen Must hold a full AU drivers licence Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent hands-on experience 3+ years’ experience in IT support, end User Compute or Service Desk environments, with demonstrated Level 3 capability A genuine love of troubleshooting: you are drawn to the messy, hard-to-reproduce problems and stay with them until they are solved Deep hands-on diagnostic skills across Windows 11, macOS and mobile platforms, covering endpoint performance, application faults, connectivity and device compliance Strong Microsoft 365 administration across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, with working knowledge of Entra ID and Intune A real passion for customer service: you take ownership, keep people informed, and explain technical issues in plain language rather than jargon Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira, and the ability to work onsite 5 days per week and participate in rostered phone coverage Preferred Qualifications Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator (MD-102), or ITIL Foundation Scripting experience with PowerShell for automation and bulk administration Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN and Wi-Fi troubleshooting About Us Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed organisation that develops and operates Australia’s essential service networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence and social infrastructure. Our work supports and connects communities across the nation. Benefits of working with us Growth – Career development and internal mobility opportunities across our diverse business. Discounts – Access to hundreds of retail and service discounts including Woolworths, JB Hi-Fi, Airbnb and Bupa. Paid leave – Parental, cultural, community service, study, corporate volunteering and purchased leave options. Culture – A workplace that values diversity, inclusion and celebrates excellence. How to apply Please submit your interest using the Apply button, where you will be directed to create a profile on our system. We celebrate diversity at Service Stream and welcome applications from Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability or neurodivergence, and those from LGBTIQA+, Veteran or other diverse groups. Applications will not be accepted via email. If you require reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please email talent.corporate@servicestream.com.au.

review_candidates.title: Senior Infraestructure project engineer (MX) (english fluent)
review_candidates.description: Job Description: Infrastructure Project Engineer (Facilities & IT Execution) Location: Mexico (Guadalajara / Monterrey) Employment Type: Full-Time On-site presence required at active project facilities in Mexico (e.g., Monterrey, Guadalajara), with potential travel to future North American expansion sites. English good level Ingeniero de Proyectos de Infraestructura (Infrastructure Project Engineer) Buscamos un Ingeniero de Proyectos de Infraestructura con amplia experiencia y perfil hands-on, responsable de liderar la ejecución técnica, supervisar proveedores locales y realizar la puesta en marcha de instalaciones en proyectos de construcción y expansión de campus industriales y corporativos con múltiples edificios. Reportando directamente al Senior Infrastructure Program Manager y recibiendo asesoramiento arquitectónico y técnico del Senior Technical Advisor, será la principal autoridad técnica en los sitios de construcción activos. En este puesto, será responsable de transformar los diseños de infraestructura de alto nivel en instalaciones físicas operativas. Tendrá a su cargo la gestión directa de empresas contratistas locales de diferentes especialidades, incluyendo instalaciones eléctricas, cableado estructurado, seguridad física, control de acceso y despliegues de redes inalámbricas. Su principal objetivo será inspeccionar, validar, configurar y poner en funcionamiento todas las capas físicas y lógicas de IT e instalaciones (Facilities), garantizando el cumplimiento de los estándares internacionales de ingeniería (TIA-568/607, BICSI) y de las regulaciones eléctricas mexicanas (NOM-001-SEDE). Principales responsabilidades y funciones 1. Supervisión técnica de empresas contratistas locales - Gestión de especialidades: Supervisar y dirigir a los contratistas mexicanos encargados de las instalaciones de infraestructura física, incluyendo cableado de baja tensión, conexiones eléctricas de alta tensión, canalizaciones y tendido de conductos, montaje de puntos de acceso Wi-Fi e instalación de dispositivos de seguridad física. - Inspección de calidad de las instalaciones: Realizar inspecciones diarias en obra de las salas MDF/IDF, distribución de racks, canalizaciones de cables, reservas de cable (service loops), asegurando reservas de 15 pies para puntos de acceso y cámaras, sistemas de puesta a tierra y equipotencialidad según TIA-607-D, y sellado de gabinetes con clasificación NEMA/IP para ambientes industriales con alta presencia de polvo. - Verificación de preparación del sitio: Auditar las condiciones físicas del lugar (terminaciones de paredes, ubicación del mobiliario y disponibilidad de energía eléctrica) antes de autorizar el inicio de los trabajos de cableado e instalación de hardware, evitando desperdicio de horas de trabajo y costos adicionales por cambios. 2. Ingeniería de infraestructura física y sistemas de red - Cableado estructurado y backbone de fibra óptica: Validar las rutas del backbone de fibra óptica monomodo OS2 (entre MDF e IDF) y los tendidos horizontales de cableado Categoría 6. Exigir pruebas OTDR bidireccionales del 100% de los enlaces de fibra óptica y certificación de los canales de cobre. - Implementación de redes y conectividad inalámbrica: Configurar, preparar e implementar switches Cisco Meraki, firewalls/routers y puntos de acceso Wi-Fi industriales. Realizar relevamientos inalámbricos pasivos posteriores a la instalación para verificar que los mapas de cobertura cumplan con los niveles de señal requeridos: mínimo de −67 dBm en 5 GHz y SNR igual o superior a 25 dB, incluso en entornos industriales con alta presencia de estructuras metálicas. - Conectividad Multi-WAN y redundancia: Configurar y probar pares de routers/firewalls de alta disponibilidad (HA), utilizando sondas de monitoreo de pérdida de paquetes, latencia y jitter en diferentes circuitos WAN (fibra óptica dedicada, Starlink, microondas y LTE/5G). - Protección eléctrica y monitoreo ambiental: Verificar el dimensionamiento y la instalación de sistemas UPS online de doble conversión en las salas MDF/IDF, sensores de monitoreo ambiental (temperatura, humedad y humo) y sistemas de transferencia automática (ATS) para generadores eléctricos de respaldo. 3. Integración de sistemas de seguridad física e instalaciones - Control de acceso y registro horario: Supervisar la implementación de sistemas de control de acceso compatibles con tarjetas gráficas ICT ISO de 13,56 MHz e impresoras Magicard 300, integrados con la plataforma Rhombus. Garantizar también el funcionamiento de las funcionalidades de registro de entrada y salida del personal de manufactura. - CCTV e interfaces con sistemas de instalaciones: Supervisar la ubicación y conexión de red de cámaras de seguridad IP, detectores de monitoreo de alarmas contra incendios, sistemas de enmascaramiento de sonido y puntos de conexión de red especializados para maquinaria industrial. 4. Puesta en marcha, pruebas y documentación técnica - Validación de sistemas: Liderar las pruebas y la puesta en marcha de los sistemas, incluyendo pruebas de conmutación por falla de circuitos WAN, autonomía de baterías UPS, simulacros de transferencia a generadores eléctricos y redundancia de enlaces de switches. - Control de calidad de la documentación: Recopilar, revisar y validar los documentos técnicos originales proporcionados por los contratistas locales, incluyendo planos de sitio y distribución en AutoCAD, topologías de red de capas L2/L3 en Visio, planillas Excel de cableado y direccionamiento IP, resultados de pruebas y manuales operativos bilingües. Requisitos y experiencia - Ubicación y disponibilidad para viajar: Residir en México (preferentemente con acceso a importantes centros industriales como Monterrey o Guadalajara) y contar con disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en proyectos de construcción y expansión de instalaciones. - Experiencia: Más de 6 años de experiencia práctica en ingeniería de infraestructura, supervisión de cableado estructurado, implementación de redes o integración de sistemas en campus industriales y centros de datos. Conocimientos técnicos requeridos - Networking: Cisco Meraki / Catalyst. Switching y routing. Segmentación de VLAN (Corporativo, OT/Manufactura, Voz, Guest, IoT). 802.1X/RADIUS. DHCP/DNS. Implementación de políticas de firewall. - Cableado estructurado: Conocimiento avanzado de ANSI/TIA-568/607. Pruebas OTDR de fibra óptica OS2. Cableado horizontal Cat6. Estándares de etiquetado e identificación de cables. - Instalaciones eléctricas e infraestructura física: Sistemas UPS online de doble conversión. Rack PDUs (unidades de distribución eléctrica para racks). Integración de generadores eléctricos con sistemas ATS. Controles ambientales para gabinetes industriales. - Seguridad física: Cámaras de videovigilancia IP (CCTV). Sistemas de control de acceso mediante tarjetas RFID. Integraciones de relés de baja tensión y sistemas de alarma contra incendios. Certificaciones (deseables) Cisco CCNA / CCNP (Routing & Switching o Wireless) o Meraki ECMS. Certificación BICSI Installer/Technician o credencial equivalente en cableado estructurado. Conocimientos de seguridad y cumplimiento de normas OSHA o STPS (Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social de México).

review_candidates.title: Sr Cybersecurity Engineer
review_candidates.description: If you like solving complex IT problems using your deep analytical skills, this is the opportunity for you! The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer will spearhead the design, testing, and implementation of secure operating systems, networks, and security monitoring tools. This expert-level role entails managing IT security systems, leading incident responses, conducting thorough risk assessments, and developing comprehensive security controls. The Senior Engineer will also drive the research and integration of cutting-edge security tools and technologies to enhance the company's security infrastructure. As SNC's corporate team, we provide the company and its business areas with strategic direction and business support spanning executive management, finance and accounting, operations, human resources, legal, IT, information security, facilities, marketing, and communications. Responsibilities Platform Ownership. Manage and own continuous improvement of a portfolio of security operations platforms, including enterprise logging and detection platforms consumed by security operations analysts. Partner with security operations analysts to optimize platform performance and effectiveness. Architectural Alignment. Partner with the Principal Architect to ensure the enterprise security platforms/tools portfolio meets architectural requirements and effectively mitigates enterprise security risks, including coverage and gap analysis, dependency management, and capability planning. Zero Trust Alignment. Support enterprise security engineering alignment with Zero Trust principals and continuous maturity of Zero Trust posture through delivery of device, network, workload, and data security controls. Standardization and Continuous Improvement. Work with junior engineers to develop and document security control standards, tool management standards, and continuous improvement roadmaps to ensure effective platform management and ongoing optimization of enterprise security controls. Risk Management. Analyze, assess, and advise on risk treatment for identified enterprise security risks including design and implementation of technical controls, compensating control identification, and documentation. Controls and compliance evidence. Develop and implement security controls mapped to NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, and local security policy requirements. Provide technical evidence and design documentation to support audits and assessments. Mentoring. Mentor and coach junior engineers on advanced security practices, platform maturity, and strategic thinking. Collaboration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to ensure robust security integration across all IT projects. Qualifications You Must Have Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Information Technology or related Engineering field of study 8+ years of experience in a related role. Relevant experience can be considered as a substitute for the required educational qualifications. In the absence of a degree, a minimum of 12 years of related experience is required. Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience. Deep and extensive understanding of cybersecurity principles and network architectures. Proven leadership experience with security monitoring and assessment tools. Demonstrated experience supporting, troubleshooting, and administering a variety of networks, Operating Systems (OSs), and applications. Expert knowledge of data security administration principles, methods, and techniques. Strong knowledge and experience administering a variety of current Microsoft platforms. Advanced understanding of domain structures, user authentication, and digital signatures. Hands-on engineering experience in a zero trust architecture environment, focused on security operations platforms including network detection and response, endpoint protection, and data security. Demonstrated ability to work with a security architect or senior technical leader and engineer the solutions they present, taking architecture direction through design, implementation, and documentation. Qualifications We Prefer Advanced technical security certifications such as ISC2 Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), CompTIA Certified Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+)/SecurityX, or GIAC certifications Expert knowledge of how enterprise security platforms orchestrate to support security operations requirements, including demonstrated experience maturing and optimizing enterprise security platforms Demonstrated success in defining and leading implementation of platform management standards and requirements Demonstrated experience implementing infrastructure-as-code or other automated security platform management methodologies Demonstrated experience working in regulated or high-sensitivity enterprise environments such as aerospace and defense, healthcare, or finance Advanced understanding of domain structures, user authentication, and digital signatures, including PKI and certificate services. Exceptional leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Ability to read and interpret security and technical documentation. Essential Functions Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment. Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Ability to lift up to 20 pounds occasionally. Ability to travel as needed. This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs. Estimated Starting Salary Range: $150,661.49 - $207,159.55. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors, such as candidates' key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. SNC offers annual incentive pay based upon performance that is commensurate with the level of the position. SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Important Notice This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use. Learn more about the background check process for Security Clearances. SNC is a global leader in aerospace and national security committed to moving the American Dream forward. We’re known and respected for our mission and execution focus, agility, and disruptive and rapid innovation. We provide leading edge technologies and transformative solutions that support our nation’s most critical security needs. If you are mission-focused, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make our country stronger with state-of-the-art technologies that safeguard freedom, join our team! SNC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an environment free of discrimination. Employment decisions are made based on merit without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law.

(NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications. The position works across design and development domains to create, review, and document system-level operational concepts, ensuring seamless platform integration and rigorous verification and validation of complex system designs against functional specifications. Additional responsibilities include contributing to proposal development through technical writing, cost estimating, and presentations, as well as producing high-quality technical documentation, specifications, and standards. Responsibilities And Tasks Attend customer meetings to understand requirements related to linear and nonlinear control systems, including digital controls. Work within the control systems design and development domain. Review, develop, and document system-level operational concepts and mission statements. Understand platform integration requirements at the platform level. Perform verification and validation of highly complex system designs to ensure conformance with functional specifications and customer requirements. Support proposal development activities, including proposal text development, cost estimating, and presentations. Produce and review technical documents, specifications, and standards. Effectively document and communicate designs, results, reports, status updates, and presentations. Work independently and collaboratively with internal and external organizations. Travel domestically and internationally as required. Skills & Abilities Knowledge of approximation and Kalman filters. Knowledge of inertial sensors. Working knowledge of the C programming language and MATLAB. Experience designing and developing time-domain and frequency-domain control systems. Ability to develop models and simulations of dynamic systems in Simulink. Education, Experience, License, Or Certification Bachelor of Science degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, aeronautical engineering, or another relevant discipline. Five or more years of experience in servo control, motion control, or navigation. Proven experience in classical linear and nonlinear control, including digital control, preferred. review_candidates.title: Data Center Operations Technician
review_candidates.description: Location: Austin Compensation: $65,000 - $75,000 / year Description Join the dynamic team at Brivo as a Senior Data Center Technician , where you will play a critical role in building, maintaining, and expanding our global data center infrastructure. This position requires strong hands-on technical expertise in server hardware, Linux systems, storage, networking, and data center power infrastructure. The ideal candidate is an experienced, self-motivated technician capable of independently troubleshooting complex hardware issues, leading equipment deployments, and maintaining high standards of operational reliability. You will collaborate with engineering, networking, and infrastructure teams to support mission-critical systems while mentoring junior technicians and improving operational processes. This role offers the opportunity to work with enterprise-scale infrastructure, contribute to global expansion projects, and help shape the reliability and efficiency of Brivo's data center operations. Key Responsibilities Data Center Operations & Infrastructure Lead the installation, configuration, maintenance, and decommissioning of servers, storage systems, and network equipment across global data centers. Assemble and troubleshoot server hardware, including motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage drives, RAID controllers, power supplies, and network interfaces. Perform rack installations, structured cabling, fiber connectivity, and power distribution while maintaining high standards of organization and safety. Monitor and manage rack power consumption, PDU utilization, cooling, and infrastructure capacity. Execute preventive maintenance and hardware replacement activities to ensure infrastructure availability. Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Management Independently diagnose and resolve complex server, storage, networking, and hardware failures. Utilize Linux diagnostic tools, BMC/IPMI, system event logs, and hardware monitoring platforms to identify and resolve issues.
